audience: business teams and developers who check customer and company data with Abstract API

useCases.title: Check an email address or a phone number
useCases.text: The AI checks an email for deliverability, disposable or role flags and breaches, or a phone number for carrier, line type, location and risk.

useCases.title: Check a VAT number or an IBAN
useCases.text: The AI checks whether a VAT number is valid and returns the registered company name and address, or checks the structure and check digits of an IBAN.

useCases.title: Work out a price with or without VAT
useCases.text: The AI calculates the amount without VAT, the VAT amount and the rate for a country, or works backwards from a price with VAT. It can also list a country's VAT rates.

useCases.title: Convert an amount between currencies
useCases.text: The AI converts an amount at the latest rate or at a past date, and lists exchange rates for a base currency.

useCases.title: Look up an IP address or a company by domain
useCases.text: The AI reads location and VPN, proxy, Tor and abuse flags of an IP, or firmographic data of a company domain: industry, size, address and social profiles.

useCases.title: Check public holidays and local times
useCases.text: The AI lists public holidays of a country for a date, month or year, gets the local time of a place, and converts a time between two places.
